svg.title: CampusLoop Four-Tier Runtime Architecture
svg.text: Authoritative relational state in PostgreSQL 16 decoupled from ephemeral realtime fanout, binary object buckets, and fail-closed advisory services
Modular routers: auth, market, transactions, governance, moderation
Pydantic V2 StrictInput (extra=forbid) & uniform BusinessError envelope
5-tier row lock order: auth -> product -> offer -> order -> meetup
Dual-bucket S3v4 media sanitizer (Pillow EXIF strip, <= 5 MiB)
Signed 64-bit BIGINT lookup bounds & scoped 401/423 guards
Partial unique active order & report indexes
Authoritative state for all trades & audits
• Compose: separate API, Worker & M7/M8 containers
• Audits: dedicated DB + Redis DB14/15 isolation
M7 keyword ranker; M8 price, Bayesian trust & 5 risk clues
Bearer token >= 32 B; 1.5 s timeout; degraded local fallback
POST /score (3.0 s HTTP); RRF hybrid fusion + scope filter
Falls back cleanly to frozen M7 keyword baseline on error
Public catalog text only; span mask & ALLOWED_ORIGINS
Isolated from private chats, reports, decisions & appeals
Optional public catalog text only (browser display path; zero private records)
Bounded advisory RPC (validated, no business writes)
Optional auxiliary service (graceful fallback when disabled)
